title: T2 HowTo: on-load execution
desc: T2 domain tier of on-load. Session-start execution commands -- mandatory skill loads, skill news, handoff recovery, suggest backlog Opus delegation, wkharness status, agent rules, skill-edit discipline, wkedit rule, TODO sync, post-fix rule, nightly schedule, Gmail sync. T1 = on-load. T3 history = on-load-ref.
steps: MANDATORY SKILL LOADS at session-start/post-compaction. wkappbot skill read suggest-workflow, then wkappbot skill read ask-suggest-priority-batching. First session also: wkappbot skill read claude-md-guide. Failure -> skip + report.

SKILL NEWS. wkappbot skill news (default 7 days) at session start -- shows NEW/UPD skills since last week. More useful than skill list. skill-list-guard warns on Edit/Write if neither was run this session.

HANDOFF/CONTEXT RECOVERY. wkappbot session list with --claude --cwd shows current and previous sessions. Tail prev JSONL via Get-Content prev.jsonl -Encoding UTF8 -Tail 150. Extract last user request + unfinished items + proposed next step. Post-compaction: tail current too. Full mechanics: wkappbot skill read claude-session-handoff. PREFERRED SHORTCUT (2026-05-16): wkappbot session handoff CLI -- shows recent turns + tool summaries, falls back to manual JSONL only if needed.

SUGGEST BACKLOG. wkappbot suggest list then Agent model opus with prompt that loads suggest-workflow + ask-suggest-priority-batching + on-load and triages the list (priority: BUG-AUTO -> important -> AI-NEWS merge). SCOPE FILTER MANDATORY: act ONLY on suggests in YOUR app or project or duty domain (see on-load-ref for full incident).

WKHARNESS health. 12 PreToolUse guards active. Run wkharness with -Status switch via PowerShell tool. Details: wkappbot skill read wkharness-guards. CDP: project-scoped only, never cross project boundaries.

AGENT RULES MANDATORY. Every Agent() call prompt MUST contain 3+ wkappbot skill read id refs -- agents start with zero context, skill reads are the only briefing. Use wkappbot skill search kw1 kw2 to find valid IDs FIRST (guard 7 validates each ID exists). Guard block (PreToolUse:Agent hook error / No stderr): add refs and retry Agent(). NEVER do the work yourself after a block = harness violation. Tier routing: wkappbot skill read claude-code-agent-tier-routing (Haiku=survey, Codex=splits/refactor, Opus=judgment, Triad=ambiguous).

SKILL EDIT DISCIPLINE. NEVER directly Edit or Write skill JSON files -- guard 4 blocks it; pipe char is step separator, direct edits corrupt steps + miss version bump + drop from skill search. ALWAYS use wkappbot skill edit id or wkappbot skill contribute. Mistaken direct edit: git checkout the path, wkappbot skill read id to verify clean, redo via skill edit.

WKEDIT RULE MANDATORY. Multi-file edits AND any file containing multibyte chars (Korean, CJK, emoji) MUST use wkedit, never Edit or Write directly (silent CRLF or encoding corruption). Pattern: wkedit file1 file2 file3. Single-file ASCII-only edits MAY use Edit tool.

TODO SYNC. Check repo project Pending section at session start. All tasks must be tracked there. Mark completed items with x and commit immediately after finishing each task. Project Pending is canonical source.

POST-FIX RULE. After each bug fix or new feature, immediately add requirement to the relevant skill: wkappbot skill add-requirement id with cmd arrow expected. Prevents context debt in future sessions.
NIGHTLY SCHEDULE. Session start: ensure CronCreate nightly (13 4 * * *) registered before wk-only-gate. Add gg todo to Pending before Agent calls (claude-md-sync-guard).
GMAIL SYNC step in gg workflow. After naver sync run the gmail mail sync python script from personal-docs. Outputs in resume drafts gmail folder.

KEY SKILLS 2026-05-31: skill-migration-3tier (split fat skills), skill-3tier-lazy-arch (design), token-economy (Haiku 33% KPI), pre-commit-full-block-plan (bypass roadmap), sonnet-bug-stop-policy (Sonnet bug patterns + harness TODOs), wkagent-name-tool (AI identity), claudemd-slim-plan (CLAUDE.md optimization). Tag search: wkappbot skill search skill-tree

ON-LOAD GATE DETECTS LITERAL NAMES ONLY (2026-06-18 gotcha): the on-load compliance gate scans the session JSONL for 'wkappbot skill read <literal-id>'. If you batch the mandatory reflex reads through a SHELL LOOP VARIABLE (e.g. 'for s in a b c; do wkappbot skill read $s; done'), the JSONL records 'wkappbot skill read $s' -- the literal id is NEVER written, so the gate still reports the reads MISSING and HARD-BLOCKS your tools (incl the Agent tool). FIX: read each mandatory reflex skill with its LITERAL id (a ; -chain of literal 'wkappbot skill read on-load ; wkappbot skill read agent-cmd ; ...' is fine; a $var loop is not). Also note: an upstream hook error can MASK this gate -- once the error is fixed the gate re-activates (see [[incident-trauma-reflex]]).

HOW TO ACTUALLY CLEAR THE TWO on-load BLOCKS, measured 2026-08-18 (Opus) because guessing costs a round trip each. (1) PREDECESSOR-LETTER BLOCK -- the message reads 'BLOCKED -- predecessor handoff letter not read' and it is cleared ONLY by the Read tool on HANDOFF.md, or by skill commands. A Bash cat of HANDOFF.md does NOT clear it, however completely you read the file, because the detector looks for a Read tool call and not for the bytes reaching your context. (2) CLAUDE-MD-NOT-IN-CONTEXT BLOCK -- the message names two literal commands, cat of the global file and cat of the project file, and it IS cleared by running those as real Bash calls even though both files are already in your system prompt. TRAP inside that remedy: do not append a redirect to /dev/null to silence the output. The CLAUDE.md write-block rule matches any greater-than sign followed later on the same line by CLAUDE.md, so the silencing redirect is read as a write to CLAUDE.md and blocks. GG FIRST ACTION -- PREDECESSOR'S LETTER FIRST (user 2026-06-30): the gg/ggg Main Workflow MUST begin by reading your predecessor's letter top-to-bottom BEFORE any other gg step -- the committed HANDOFF.md at repo root (prior letters: git show HEAD~1:HANDOFF.md), or the project's equivalent handoff doc. It holds the current DONE / CRITICAL-FIRST / OPEN state. This is step 2 of the gg Main Workflow in the project CLAUDE.md; honor it across every repo even when the local gg section has not yet been updated.

STALE-SKILL SPOT-FIX REFLEX (user 2026-07-02): when a skill you READ (any skill, any tier) surfaces content that is clearly OUTDATED -- describes a bug already fixed, a file/path that no longer exists, a 'pending'/'TODO' item already landed, a design already superseded -- do NOT just silently note it and move on. Fix it THE MOMENT you discover it, via wkappbot skill edit (add-step correcting the record, or amend the stale step directly). WHY: every skill read is inherited by jasonmandae (all future/descendant sessions in every family) -- an intelligence that reads a stale skill and does not correct it lets every SUCCESSOR walk into the same outdated guidance forever, while the fix costs one skill-edit now. This is a standing reflex, not a scheduled chore: it complements skill-heal-nightly (the automated nightly pass) by catching staleness THE INSTANT a live session notices it, not waiting for the next heal cycle. DONE-TEST: would the next fresh session reading this same skill get the CORRECT current picture? If not, the spot-fix is not done. EXTENDED by the owner 2026-08-22, and this half is what the reflex was missing -- UPDATING is not the only sanctioned outcome. Judge each stale step by UPKEEP COST AGAINST VALUE: a step whose maintenance costs more than it returns should be DELETED outright, not lovingly rewritten, because every future session pays to read it. Where the only remaining worth of a dead step is stopping someone re-inventing the thing that failed, keep it but retag it DEPRECATED so the warning survives while the instruction stops being followed. So the three outcomes are UPDATE, DELETE, or DEPRECATE, and picking the cheapest correct one is the job -- a catalog that only ever grows is a catalog nobody finishes reading. Deletion here means the guarded content-addressed form, wkappbot skill edit <id> --delete-step N --quote '<verbatim fragment>', never a raw file edit; the quote is mandatory precisely so a delete cannot land on the wrong step. This applies while doing ORDINARY appbot work, not as a scheduled chore: the moment a step you just read proves stale, decide which of the three it earns and do it in that turn. Cross: skill-heal-nightly (the scheduled complement), foundation-is-roots-charge-not-a-chore (harness-embodiment reflex), knowledge-ification-procedure-jisikhwa.

NAVIGATION: this skill is an entry-point router for session-start behavior, not an always-execute checklist. WHEN: (A) session start or post-compaction, run steps 1+2 below. (B) user sends exactly 'gg' or 'ggg' (case-insensitive, trim whitespace), run the GG TRIGGER step. (C) user says 'handoff' or 'continue from last session', run the HANDOFF step. (D) user is mid-task or sent a casual greeting, do NOT run the full pipeline. HOW: wkappbot skill read on-load-howto for the exact step sequence and commands for each case. WHY: routing correctly avoids wasting tokens on the full pipeline for casual messages and avoids derailing work already in progress.

GG TRIGGER: if user message is exactly 'gg' or 'ggg' (case-insensitive, trim whitespace -- GG/Gg/ggg all match), locate '## gg Main Workflow' section in project CLAUDE.md and execute every step sequentially without confirmation. Continue on non-fatal step failures; report summary at end. If CLAUDE.md is missing OR has no gg section: stop here and follow step 5 to create it BEFORE executing. Do not re-invoke on-load from within the new section (circular reference).

CHECK SUGGEST BACKLOG (session start / post-compaction only): wkappbot suggest list. Then follow ask-suggest-priority-batching protocol -- MANDATORY, no shortcuts: (1) merge obvious duplicates. (2) fire wkappbot ask gpt --new-session for batch ranking. (3) STOP and wait for GPT response -- do not burn Sonnet tokens while waiting. (4) per actionable item: fire wkappbot ask gpt with ts+title+root-cause BEFORE any code. (5) only after ask responses arrive: brief Opus agent with ask result + fix path. Fatal = command not found / auth failure. Non-fatal = empty list / timeout. Success: Opus agent reports resolved/skipped counts.

REFLECTION CHAIN: before starting work, check if you hit any recurring pattern this session. If yes, add it to sonnet-bug-stop-policy-ref: wkappbot skill read sonnet-bug-stop-policy-ref. P7=guard-source-first (read guard source at retry #2, not #6). P8=asymmetric-protection (ask: does my guard protect in both directions?). Future Sonnet is watching.

WHEN TO RUN. (A) session start or post-compaction -> load mandatory skills (see on-load-howto step 2) + run handoff (on-load-howto step 4) + run suggest backlog (on-load-howto step 5). (B) user sends exactly gg or ggg -> run GG TRIGGER (T1 step 2). (C) mid-task or casual greeting -> SKIP full pipeline.

GG TRIGGER. User message exactly gg or ggg -> locate the gg Main Workflow section in project root markdown rules file and execute every step sequentially end-to-end NO confirmation, finish with repo-health-doctor. If section missing: ask user for recurring tasks, add the gg Main Workflow section, then run it same session. Quota/limit error: mark handoff_pending, do NOT retry same CLI.

ON-LOAD BLOCK UNREACHABLE FOR CLAUDE, measured 2026-10-05: the hard block last fired 2026-09-06 from the old unified entry (wkharness.ps1 -Family claude); the live Claude PreToolUse entry wkharness-claude-main.ps1 loads wkharness-guards.ps1 only at line 1511, after its fast paths (git, Agent.cmd, wkappbot skill, read tools) exit, so a session skips on-load and its own reflection for hours with PostToolUse warnings only. Fix: call Test-WkOnLoadComplianceBlock right after emergency9 in wkharness-claude-main.ps1, exempt only pure knowledge-op reads, prove it with one Bash call from a non-compliant session (landed kih 416735c14, 2026-10-05: module Get-WkOnLoadEarlyBlockReason plus one seam line after the REFLEX.md rule line, live proof a git call refused with on-load BLOCKED). Probe recipe: fake transcript and payload under .tmp, pipe the payload to the real entry, always run a control that must be refused. 2026-09-01: Codex post-hook on-load enforcement now dot-sources wkharness-guards-onload-enforce.ps1, runs Test-WkOnLoadCompliance, and mirrors the on-load additionalContext nudge into _wkPostNudgeContext when noncompliant so the guidance survives PostToolUse. //why:codex exemption narrowed and landed //why:probe needs real transcript shape-sonnet //why:probe needs real transcript shape-sonnet //why:codex exemption narrowed and landed-sonnet

FORCE DYNAMIC (FRESH) SKILL LOADING AT SESSION START (user 2026-06-05, ALL SESSIONS incl. the core-handler): do NOT rely only on the locally-cached skill files -- a session that loads just the cache runs on STALE skills (the wkappbot-core-handler session was observed at on-load loading only cached files, never pulling newer versions). On-load MUST refresh dynamically: read each mandatory/relevant skill with the --if-newer flag (wkappbot skill read <id> --if-newer -- cheap: it fetches from HQ ONLY when the HQ version is newer than the local cache), and/or trigger a catalog sync at start so the local cache is refreshed before you act. The Eye syncs HQ roughly every 30 min, but a fresh session must NOT wait for that window -- force the refresh itself. This is cross-repo: Claude, Codex, and the core-handler all apply it at on-load. Cost is one cheap version-check per skill; correctness (latest knowledge) outranks the tiny latency. //why:verify sector numbers before landing them //why:verify sector numbers before landing them-sonnet //why:fresh reads keep sessions on current knowledge
